_comment: Where every bundled asset file came from - see README.md. Each key is a path relative to the repository root. Every entry needs a description, a source (where it came from: a URL, or the session/commit that created it) and a license. The app's own work (LicenseRef-LudoPlus-AllRightsReserved - see /LICENSE) also needs its copyright line. A third-party asset instead lists, in "libraries", the libraries/ entry for each source it was made from - those carry the license, copyright/credit and source URL, and are what the Licences dialog shows; "license" is the license of that source material. The build fails on any asset missing from here, any incomplete entry, and any entry whose file no longer exists.

app/shared/src/commonMain/composeResourc.description: LudoPlus D20: Andika Bold, for the D20 dice's numbers - its 1 has a foot and its 7 is crossed, so neither reads as the other. Modified, a modification the OFL permits: cut down to the digits 0-9, the crossed seven (Andika's seven.Bar) made the 7, and renamed, as the OFL requires of a modified font with a Reserved Font Name, by scripts/subset-d20-font.sh from the original kept in app/licensing/sources/ (ofl/andika/Andika-Bold.ttf in github.com/google/fonts)

LudoPlus Maths Italic: MathJax_Math Italic (Computer Modern math italic, as in Wikipedia's formulas) for the Maths dice's x, e and π - modified, a modification the OFL permits: cut down to those characters and renamed, as the OFL requires of a modified font with a Reserved Font Name, by scripts/subset-maths-fonts.sh from the original kept in app/licensing/sources/ (fonts/HTML-CSS/TeX/otf/MathJax_Math-Italic.otf in MathJax 2.7.9)

LudoPlus Maths Regular: MathJax_Main Regular (Computer Modern roman, as in Wikipedia's formulas) for the Maths dice's digits, root sign, floor brackets, "ln" and factorial and the Poker dice's ranks - modified, a modification the OFL permits: cut down to those characters and renamed, as the OFL requires of a modified font with a Reserved Font Name, by scripts/subset-maths-fonts.sh from the original kept in app/licensing/sources/ (fonts/HTML-CSS/TeX/otf/MathJax_Main-Regular.otf in MathJax 2.7.9)

Sora, reduced to a static weight-700 instance subset to ASCII and Latin-1, for the wordmark, titles and game-board marks (commit f939500/fce850f; Latin-1 added later) - a modification the OFL permits; Sora declares no Reserved Font Name, so the name can stay
